svg.title: Word error rate across sampling steps for all seven layouts
svg.desc: Baseline, CYCLE 9 by 2, SEQUENCE 9 by 2, CYCLE 6 by 3, Prefix, Middle, and Suffix at 4, 8, 16, and 32 steps. All are 500k EMA models with 18 block calls per network evaluation. Fixed inference seeds: Seed-TTS 666, LibriSpeech-PC 0. Insets enlarge 8 to 32 steps. Values differ from the multi-seed quality comparison.
